title.rendered: #1 Wedding Photo App for Guests: Start Capturing Memories | GUESTPIX

content.rendered:
Event Photo Sharing App?
Here's something better.

GUESTPIX is the fun and easy way for your event guests to share photos and videos instantly, without downloading a photo sharing app!

Create My Gallery
How It Works

Looking for a photo sharing app for your event?

Asking your guests to download a photo sharing app for your event is the last thing they’ll want to do. GUESTPIX is the app-free way to collect all your guests photos, videos and even guestbook messages in real-time with a quick scan of our QR code. It gives you the same fun, instant app-like experience without making your guests download anything.

Upload in Real Time, Treasure for All Time

Wake up to the memories you missed and the ones you never want to forget in your private photo album! You’ll receive photos, videos and even guestbook messages. It’s perfect for past or upcoming events and the perfect way to connect guests who can’t be there.

As the memories keep rolling in, you and your guests will love checking back to see what’s new. When you’re ready, download your entire gallery in original resolution to keep and treasure forever.

It's so easy. Don't miss a moment!

Pricing
Get Started Free

The Best Photo Sharing App Experience – Minus the App

Instant Gratification

Enjoy photos and videos added in real-time. Guests will love adding their POV – no photo sharing app required! 

Match Your Event Style

Match your guest photo album to your event style or theme. Choose colors and fonts so everything is cohesive. 

Sharing That Feels Safe (Cos It Is)

With privacy and security built in, your digital photo album stays protected as only invited guests can view and contribute.

Real-Time Slideshow

Enjoy the slideshow as new photos and videos are automatically added after every rotation. It’s a guaranteed crowd pleaser.

Albums For All The Action

 Create multiple event photo albums to keep your event memories organized. 

Highly Customizable

Our digital gallery settings are highly customizable so you can tailor it to your specific event needs.

Full Res Downloads

Everything uploaded to your gallery is available to download in original resolution in a single zip file.

Engagement: Comments & Likes

The private social feed is here! Guests can comment and like content should you wish to use this feature in the platform.

100% Your Memories

Above all – you and your guests retain ownership of all content, not us. We simply safekeep the memories for you.

How It Works

GUESTPIX is designed exclusively for events. It’s easy to use, fun to experience and is the one investment you’ll have long after the event is over. A bank of memories from everyone’s perspective that you get to keep forever. 

➀ Join Your Event Guests scan your QR code or use your private link to access your gallery
➁ Capture & Upload Guests can take photos and videos directly in the app or upload any taken on their camera. It automatically syncs to the gallery and there's no photo limits so you get the most out of it!
➂ Enjoy The Memories You and your guests can enjoy the memories captured in your gallery. As the host, you can download your gallery or private photo albums in full resolution at any time.
NO APP NEEDED +

NO GUEST REGISTRATION - GUESTS JUST SCAN & UPLOAD

There’s no need to ask guests to register or download a photo sharing app! Your GUESTPIX QR code / private link is how your guests add their photos, videos & guestbook messages that are collected in one gallery everyone can enjoy. 

2 mins to set up, it's so easy!

Pricing
